visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied in a bun is submerged in a swimming pool lined with bright green square tiles. She is wearing a red one-piece swimsuit and holds pink flower petals delicately in her cupped hands. The environment is flooded with natural daylight, and white stylized text reading 'summer' with beach-themed icons is overlaid on the frame. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman's shoulder and neck. Her hand, showing black nail polish, pulls away a white towel, revealing the thin red strap of her swimwear against her pale skin. (3) A series of brief shots show the woman's bare legs and feet standing on the green pool edge, followed by a back view of her head as she gazes toward a sandy path leading to a beach area. (4) A young man with short black hair and a bare chest appears in the same green-tiled pool. He looks into the camera lens with a brief smile before turning around and diving headfirst into the water, creating a large white splash. The background reveals a tropical resort setting with lush greenery and beach furniture.
